releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.81 includes the three approved interface updates: Files Search now uses simple circular All / Doc / Photo / Video controls with the label underneath; WhatsApp Inbox adds compact All / Images / Videos / Documents filters; and Price Photos is renamed Price Book with a two-column product catalog, circular product photos, product name and price, direct Guide button, and Add Product action. Existing local products, categories, barcodes, guides, WhatsApp source files, and file-search behavior are preserved.
